name: 74029 · Dewey, OK
findings: ZIP 74029 (Dewey) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74029 (Dewey) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74029 (Dewey) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
